lifecycle: tests/local_runtime.py owns each temporary directory and bounded compiler/test process group. New socket paths are relative inside the owned temporary cwd. Actual production worker closes transferred socket FDs; actual production main loop/inbox closes listeners/readers; bounded barriers wait for worker ownership cleanup and connector completion before return. No app, installed helper, root operation or canonical socket touched.
faultInjectionLimit: EINTR is injected at the syscall seam. Non-injected cases call actual system poll. Initial last-activity age is seeded once in the extracted loop. Only the sampler backend is a barrier substitute; existing controlled real-sampler proof remains separate and unmodified.
